one_line: A young fisher from Loktak Lake, embodying the living wetland traditions of Moirang and Keibul Lamjao.

appearance.age_look: early 20s, wiry and athletic from daily rowing and net-casting
appearance.face: oval face with warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, soft but alert dark-brown eyes with anime shine, a few sun-freckles on the cheeks, and a calm, focused default expression that hints at quiet determination
appearance.hair: straight, black hair cut in a neat, medium-length style that reaches just above the nape; front has slightly long, side-parted bangs framing the forehead, and a simple narrow white cotton headband tied at the back to keep hair from falling while fishing
appearance.costume: Era-bridging but modest, region-accurate lake-wear: a light, off-white handwoven cotton phanek-style lower garment wrapped firmly from waist to mid-calf with subtle thin maroon and dark-green horizontal stripes at the border; over it a pale sky-blue, long-sleeved, collarless cotton shirt (kurta-like) with side slits at the hip for easy movement and a short placket with three small wooden buttons; around his waist a dark maroon woven cotton belt/sash knotted slightly to the left, with one end hanging; on top when rowing he wears a sleeveless, slightly faded olive-green canvas-like vest with two front pockets for hooks and small tools; his feet are in simple brown rubber sandals with a single strap, suitable for stepping into shallow water and onto phumdi; on his right wrist a thin woven red-and-white cotton thread bracelet, and on his left a simple brass bangle, both modest and traditional; overall the fabrics look handwoven and practical, slightly worn from daily use.
appearance.signature: A long, slender bamboo fishing pole with a forked end used to guide and anchor phumdi and athapum, carried together with a conical bamboo fish trap (nga-khong) slung by a rope across his back.

ref_desc: A wiry young Loktak fisher with an oval sun-kissed face, straight black medium-length hair held by a white headband, wearing a sky-blue long-sleeved cotton shirt, off-white striped phanek, maroon sash, olive-green vest and sandals, carrying a bamboo fishing pole and conical bamboo fish trap in muted blue, off-white, maroon, olive-green and brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of a young male Loktak fisher from Moirang, showing him from multiple angles: he has an oval, sun-browned face with soft but alert dark-brown eyes and slight freckles, and straight black medium-length hair held back with a simple white cotton headband; his outfit is modest and practical, consisting of a pale sky-blue, long-sleeved, collarless cotton shirt with a short buttoned placket and hip-level side slits, an off-white handwoven phanek-style wrap from waist to mid-calf with thin maroon and dark-green horizontal border stripes, tied securely with a dark maroon woven cotton sash at the waist, a sleeveless olive-green vest with two front pockets worn over the shirt, and plain brown rubber sandals; add a thin red-and-white cotton thread bracelet on his right wrist and a simple brass bangle on his left; his body is wiry and athletic, posture balanced as someone used to balancing on phumdi, and he carries a long slender bamboo fishing pole with a forked end in one hand while a conical bamboo fish trap hangs across his back on a rope; keep the colour palette focused on sky blue, off-white, maroon, olive green and dark brown, and ensure the design feels grounded in Loktak Lake’s wetland fishing culture while retaining clean, consistent anime proportions and linework.
